risk.rationale: Confirmed account takeover chain indicators: F1 (CONFIRMED) shows valid-account sign-ins from a non-baseline Cloudvault VPS (DE) — T1078.004 — and F3 (CONFIRMED) shows the internet-facing VPN appliance runs KEV-listed firmware (T1133/T1190), providing the initial-access vector. Together they form a confirmed chain (exposed VPN edge → valid account use from attacker infrastructure). Not benign (no explanation for VPS sign-ins) and not merely monitor (findings are confirmed, not weak). DQ vpn_session_order conflict noted, but F1 stands confirmed independently and justifies containment.
